answer: Fixed-schedule attestation windows. Each identity must answer a challenge at a pre-announced time and a randomized moment within it; missing counts as failure. Because the river of challenges is unpredictable, a farmer must staff each puppet at all times, paying real attention cost per identity. Failure drops the identity behind a beacon that stops reward routing until re-earned. Colluding operators burn excess capacity on shale-grade idle shifts; the cost scales with identity count.
